name: GD_Run_Recorder
description: A run recorder that saves your successful runs as videos.

auto-record.name: Auto-record runs
auto-record.description: Record every attempt. Deaths are deleted, successful runs are kept.

save-percent.name: Save at % (normal runs)
save-percent.description: Keep a run once it reaches this percent. 100 = only completions.

startpos-save-percent.name: Save at % (start pos runs)
startpos-save-percent.description: Same, but for attempts that begin from a start pos. Set it to where your section ends.

video-height.name: Video height
video-height.description: Lower = smoother game on weak phones. 480 is a good start.
